request.prompt: Anime character design sheet, flat 2D cel-shaded illustration, clean confident ink linework, limited palette, retro-futurist 1980s OVA anime aesthetic blended with modern elegant anime key art. Character: "Seven", a cool, beautiful young woman courier, about 20. Sharp calm eyes with pale silver-grey irises, short asymmetric black bob haircut with one long side lock on the left and a single streak of signal orange, straight bangs. Wears large chunky retro over-ear headphones in cream white with an orange stripe, coiled cord. Oversized dark olive-green MA-1 flight bomber jacket with orange lining visible at the collar and cuffs, a small round patch on the left shoulder reading "07", black turtleneck underneath, dark shorts over black tights, chunky white sneakers. Three views on one sheet: front full body, three-quarter full body, and a close-up head portrait, standing on a plain warm off-white background with subtle halftone. Consistent design across all views. No text other than the "07" patch.
